title: HSK1 Gate 3 · Western Zhou
explanationEn: Gate 3: Western Zhou. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第3关：西周。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 商朝以后，中国有了西周。西周的王说：“天让我做王。”他说，天看着每一个王。王要爱人，人也要爱王。
passageEn: After the Shang, China had the Western Zhou. The Western Zhou king said: "Heaven lets me be king." He said that Heaven watches every king. The king must love the people; the people must also love the king.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: After the Shang, China had the Western Zhou.
comprehension.answer: 商朝以后，中国有了西周。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: He said that Heaven watches every king.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 商朝 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“商朝”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 商朝 (Shāngcháo) means "Shang Dynasty" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “商朝”（Shāngcháo）的意思是“Shang Dynasty”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 以后 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“以后”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 以后 (yǐ hòu) means "after" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “以后”（yǐ hòu）的意思是“after”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 商朝以后，中国有了西周。

options.text: Long ago, the waters of China were very high.
The water was very big; many people had no home.
After the Shang, China had the Western Zhou.

check.explanationEn: "商朝以后，中国有了西周。" means "After the Shang, China had the Western Zhou.".
check.explanation: “商朝以后，中国有了西周。”的意思是“After the Shang, China had the Western Zhou.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Western Zhou in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说西周。
